title: A dual enhancer-silencer element ensures transient Cdx2 expression during posterior body formation
authors: Amblard I; Baranasic D; Moyon B; Lenhard B; Metzis V
one_liner_zh: 该文通过CRISPR删除和体内外验证研究Cdx2基因座增强子-沉默子逻辑，但核心是基因调控元件功能而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: During development, cells express precise gene expression programmes to assemble the trunk of the body plan. Appropriate control over the duration of the transcription factor Cdx2 is critical to achieve this outcome, yet, how cells control the onset, maintenance or termination of Cdx2 , has remained unclear. Here, we delineate the cis-regulatory logic orchestrating dynamic Cdx2 expression in mouse caudal epiblast progenitors and their derivatives - spinal cord and presomitic mesoderm. Combining CRISPR-mediated deletion of regulatory elements with in vitro models and in vivo validation, we demonstrate that distinct enhancers, and a silencer, embedded at the Cdx2 locus, act sequentially to drive transient Cdx2 expression. We pinpoint a minimal silencer element that relies on a nuclear receptor motif to extinguish Cdx2 . Changing this single motif converts the repressive element to an enhancer with opposite regulatory behaviour. Our findings elucidate design principles of developmental enhancers and silencers and establish a dual enhancer-silencer cis-regulatory logic ensuring precise spatiotemporal control over gene expression for vertebrate body patterning.
abstract_zh: 在发育过程中，细胞表达精确的基因表达程序以构建身体躯干蓝图。对转录因子Cdx2持续时间的适当控制对于实现这一结果至关重要，然而，细胞如何控制Cdx2的启动、维持或终止，至今仍不清楚。在此，我们描绘了调控小鼠尾部外胚层祖细胞及其衍生物——脊髓和体节前中胚层中动态Cdx2表达的顺式调控逻辑。结合CRISPR介导的调控元件删除、体外模型及体内验证，我们证明嵌入在Cdx2基因座上的不同增强子及一个沉默子依次作用，驱动Cdx2的瞬时表达。我们定位了一个最小沉默子元件，其依赖核受体基序来熄灭Cdx2。改变这一单一基序可将该抑制性元件转化为具有相反调控行为的增强子。我们的发现阐明了发育增强子和沉默子的设计原理，并确立了一种双重增强子-沉默子顺式调控逻辑，确保脊椎动物体轴模式形成中基因表达的精确时空控制。
